# gate-records/ — generated by the gates

Everything here is written by the gate lifecycle, not by hand:

- `gate-log.md` — one row per gate run (appended at commit time)
- `gate-permanent-checks.md` — the findings register: standing pre-flight deltas (Table A) and User-accepted risk / ungated merges (Table B). A human adds the disposition column; nothing else is hand-edited.
- `LEGACY-INVENTORY.md` — which source files no gate has ever read (`make legacy-inventory`)
- `state/` — repo-state probe snapshots, per commit. **Gitignored.** Per-clone runtime data.
- `scan/` — `make scan` output: per-scanner JSON and logs, plus the POAM candidate list. **Gitignored.** Per-clone runtime data, same as `state/`.
